narrative.overview: This is a local record of the implemented admin boundary, not an app-wide brand specification. The interface prioritizes operating the library: choose a material, match its title, inspect artwork, and deliberately commit an artwork change. Chapter editing uses readable timestamps and plain Polish feedback.
dos: Do preserve the shared nx palette and admin typography.
Do keep all search results reachable and distinguish draft artwork from saved artwork.
Do explain the result and next useful action in plain Polish.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, busy states, and reduced-motion support.
donts: Don't promote this local workflow reference into an app-wide brand commitment.
Don't imply that a failed or partial operation completed successfully.
Don't make technical identifiers the main route through routine material editing.
